zh.summary: 先確認自己在哪個專案、使用哪個 Python 與套件，再啟動最小骨架；把安裝結果與功能驗收分開記錄。
objectives: 在獨立環境啟動起始骨架並記錄實際版本。
分辨工作目錄、直譯器、套件與執行入口。
在環境失敗時保留診斷，不冒稱已完成程式實作。

readingGuide.goal: 在獨立環境啟動起始骨架並記錄實際版本。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 解壓後工作坊根目錄、Python 3.11／3.12、終端機與瀏覽器。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: environment-notes.md 可讓同儕找到同一入口，並清楚知道骨架尚無哪些功能。

sections.heading: 一、這一課到底在教什麼？
paragraphs: 先記住一句話：
寫程式之前，先確定程式要在哪裡執行、需要哪些工具，以及怎麼證明它真的可以運作。
這就叫做建立「開發環境」（Development Environment）。
假設你告訴 AI：
「請幫我開發一個系統，讓員工上傳 Excel，檢查資料是否完整，最後輸出報告。」
AI 很可能可以快速寫出幾百行程式碼。
但接下來會遇到幾個問題：

- 程式碼放在哪個資料夾？
- 電腦有沒有安裝 Python？
- 需要安裝哪些套件？
- 為什麼 AI 的程式在另一台電腦可以跑，在你的電腦卻不能跑？
- 網頁成功開啟，是否就代表系統已完成？
- AI 說測試成功，你要如何確認它真的執行過測試？
本課就是教你解決這些問題。
最重要的觀念：環境建置成功，不等於功能開發完成；程式能啟動，也不等於系統符合需求。

sections.heading: 二、用開餐廳理解整個軟體開發環境
paragraphs: 假設你想開一家牛肉麵店。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜開餐廳與軟體開發的八組對照
blocks.description: 每組先列餐廳角色，再列對應軟體角色；寬版左右對照、窄版上下配對，沒有先後箭頭。準備、實作與驗收需分別證明。

paragraphs: 這個比喻要告訴你：
你租好了店面、買好了爐具、準備好了食材，並不代表你已經煮出一碗好吃的牛肉麵。
同樣地，安裝好 Python、開啟網頁、看到程式畫面，都不代表軟體已經完成。
這也是為什麼我們要把「環境準備」、「功能實作」和「功能驗收」分開處理。

sections.heading: 三、認識五個最重要的技術概念
paragraphs: 依序釐清位置、執行者、套件隔離、依賴與工具分工。

blocks.heading: 1. 專案目錄（Project Directory）：你現在站在哪裡？
paragraphs: 接著核對命令、用途與實際結果。
電腦裡可能有這樣的資料夾；`.venv` 在建立環境後才會出現：

blocks.heading: 範例 1｜1. 專案目錄（Project Directory）：你現在站在哪裡？
paragraphs: 依本節用途執行或保存；輸出以實際執行為準。
blocks.code:
my-project/
├── README.md
├── requirements.txt
├── starter/
│   └── app.py
├── slices/
├── reference/
└── .venv/                 # 建立環境後才會出現

paragraphs: 這裡每一項都有用途：

blocks.caption: 表 1｜三、認識五個最重要的技術概念
rows: 使用說明書，告訴你怎麼安裝、啟動
需要安裝哪些 Python 套件
已準備好的程式起始骨架
工作坊分階段實作的材料
專案自己的 Python 虛擬環境

paragraphs: 最容易犯的錯，是以為打開某個檔案，就代表終端機也進入了那個資料夾。
其實完全不是。
你可以在編輯器看到 `app.py`，但是終端機卻在另一個資料夾。
這時執行：

blocks.heading: 範例 2｜1. 專案目錄（Project Directory）：你現在站在哪裡？
paragraphs: 依本節用途執行或保存；輸出以實際執行為準。
電腦就可能回報：
`Could not open requirements file`
因為它在錯誤的位置尋找檔案。
所以第一步永遠是確認目前目錄。

blocks.heading: 範例 3｜1. 專案目錄（Project Directory）：你現在站在哪裡？
paragraphs: 依本節用途執行或保存；輸出以實際執行為準。
這是 Linux、macOS 常見的指令。在 Windows PowerShell，可使用 `Get-Location` 和 `Get-ChildItem`。

blocks.heading: 2. Python Interpreter：真正執行程式的是誰？
paragraphs: 接著核對命令、用途與實際結果。
Python 是一種程式語言，而 Python Interpreter（直譯器）是讀取並執行 Python 程式的軟體。
你的電腦可能同時裝有：

- Python 3.10
- Python 3.11
- Python 3.12
就像一家工廠可能有不同年代的生產機器。
如果程式要求 Python 3.12，卻拿 Python 3.10 執行，就可能因為語法或套件相容性而出問題。
先檢查：

blocks.heading: 範例 4｜2. Python Interpreter：真正執行程式的是誰？
paragraphs: 依本節用途執行或保存；輸出以實際執行為準。
再確認實際使用哪一個 Python：

blocks.heading: 範例 5｜2. Python Interpreter：真正執行程式的是誰？
paragraphs: 依本節用途執行或保存；輸出以實際執行為準。
第二個指令尤其重要。它會顯示 Python 執行檔所在的位置。
版本相同，不代表你正在使用同一個 Python 環境。

blocks.heading: 3. 虛擬環境（Virtual Environment）：讓各專案使用自己的套件
paragraphs: 接著核對命令、用途與實際結果。
這是本課最核心的技術觀念。
假設你同時開發三個系統：

blocks.caption: 圖 2｜同一部電腦，三個獨立專案環境
blocks.description: 三個專案平行管理套件，避免更新互相干擾；上下排列不代表執行順序。虛擬環境不提供檔案或網路安全隔離。

items.title: 醫院影像分析系統
items.body: Python 3.11 + 一組經過驗證的 AI 套件

items.title: 餐廳庫存管理系統
items.body: Python 3.12 + 另一組資料處理套件

paragraphs: 同一部電腦，也能有多個相互獨立的專案環境。
如果三個專案共用同一組套件，更新餐廳系統使用的套件時，可能意外讓醫院系統發生相容性問題。
Python 的 `venv` 就是解決這種問題的方法之一。

blocks.heading: 範例 6｜3. 虛擬環境（Virtual Environment）：讓各專案使用自己的套件
paragraphs: 依本節用途執行或保存；輸出以實際執行為準。
這行指令的意思是：
「請使用目前的 Python，在這個資料夾建立一套獨立的 Python 環境，名稱叫 `.venv`。」
它隔離的主要是 Python 套件與其執行環境。
但注意：虛擬環境不是安全沙箱（Security Sandbox）。 它不會自動阻止程式讀取其他檔案、連接網路或操作系統資源。要限制 Coding Agent 的權限，仍需要另外設計隔離和授權機制。

blocks.heading: 4. Dependencies：程式需要借助哪些外部工具？
paragraphs: 接著核對命令、用途與實際結果。
當你開發一個網站，不一定要親自寫出所有功能。
例如：

- 想做網頁介面，可以使用 Streamlit。
- 想寫自動化測試，可以使用 pytest。
- 想處理資料表，可以使用 pandas。
這些別人已經寫好的工具，在 Python 世界中通常稱為套件（Packages）。
你的程式需要依靠它們才能運作，因此稱為 Dependencies（依賴）。
例如 `requirements.txt` 可以寫：

blocks.heading: 範例 7｜4. Dependencies：程式需要借助哪些外部工具？
paragraphs: 依本節用途執行或保存；輸出以實際執行為準。
這是本課工作坊指定的兩個直接依賴版本。
其中 `==` 表示要求特定版本。
但要注意，即使寫死直接依賴的版本，也不一定鎖住所有間接依賴，更不保證跨作業系統完全一致。

blocks.heading: 5. Toolchain：開發需要哪些工具協同工作？
paragraphs: 接著核對命令、用途與實際結果。
Toolchain（工具鏈）就是把不同用途的工具串在一起，讓它們共同完成開發工作。

blocks.caption: 表 2｜三、認識五個最重要的技術概念
rows: 安裝及管理 Python 套件
管理程式碼版本與變更
協助讀寫程式、修改檔案、呼叫授權工具

paragraphs: 可以把 Coding Agent 想成一位會使用工具的工程師。
但工程師能操作電鑽，不表示電鑽本身就是工程師；Coding Agent 會執行 Python，也不表示它取代了 Python。

sections.heading: 四、實際操作：從零啟動一個 Python 專案
paragraphs: 這部分直接使用教材中的 Streamlit 工作坊作為範例。教材指定 Python 3.11 或 3.12、Streamlit 1.51.0、pytest 8.4.2。
標準操作流程

blocks.caption: 圖 3｜從定位專案到停止服務的五步流程
blocks.description: 編號與箭頭只表示操作順序；每一步都核對實際結果，啟動骨架不表示功能驗收通過。

items.title: 找到正確的專案根目錄
items.body: 確認 README、requirements.txt、starter 在預期位置。

items.title: 建立並啟用虛擬環境
items.body: 確認使用的是符合要求的 Python。

items.title: 安裝依賴套件
items.body: 確認安裝命令成功結束。

items.title: 啟動程式
items.body: 瀏覽器實際顯示起始骨架。

items.title: 停止並留下證據
items.body: 正確結束服務，記錄成功、失敗與尚未驗證的項目。

blocks.heading: 步驟 1：建立與啟用虛擬環境
paragraphs: 接著核對命令、用途與實際結果。

blocks.caption: 圖 4｜依作業系統建立與啟用環境
blocks.description: 選擇符合自己系統的一欄；兩欄是替代操作路徑，並非先後步驟。確認 Python 3.11／3.12，再核對執行檔位置。

items.title: Linux / macOS
items.body:
# 在工作坊根目錄執行
python3 --version

# 確認為 Python 3.11 或 3.12 後建立環境
python3 -m venv .venv

# 啟用虛擬環境
source .venv/bin/activate

# 查看目前 Python
python --version
python -c "import sys; print(sys.executable)"

items.title: Windows PowerShell
items.body:
Get-Location
Get-ChildItem
py -3.12 --version
py -3.12 -m venv .venv
.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
python --version
python -c "import sys; print(sys.executable)"

paragraphs: 先確認已安裝的 Python 3.11／3.12；下列以 3.12 為例，若使用 3.11，將 `-3.12` 改為 `-3.11`。`py` 是 Windows Python launcher；若未安裝，先依實際 Python 安裝方式找到直譯器。
若無法啟用，仍可直接操作同一個虛擬環境：

blocks.heading: 範例 8｜步驟 1：建立與啟用虛擬環境
paragraphs: 依本節用途執行或保存；輸出以實際執行為準。
blocks.code:
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m streamlit version
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest --version
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m streamlit run starter/app.py --server.address 127.0.0.1

paragraphs: 如果 Windows PowerShell 因安全政策禁止執行啟用腳本，先查明原因，不需要為了方便就放寬安全政策；也可以直接指定虛擬環境內的 Python 執行檔。

blocks.heading: 步驟 2：安裝需要的套件
paragraphs: 接著核對命令、用途與實際結果。

blocks.heading: 範例 9｜步驟 2：安裝需要的套件
paragraphs: 依本節用途執行或保存；輸出以實際執行為準。
為什麼用 `python -m pip`，而不是只寫 `pip`？
因為前者會使用目前選定的 Python 去執行 pip，比較容易避免把套件安裝到另一個 Python 環境。

blocks.heading: 步驟 3：確認安裝結果
paragraphs: 接著核對命令、用途與實際結果。

blocks.heading: 範例 10｜步驟 3：確認安裝結果
paragraphs: 依本節用途執行或保存；輸出以實際執行為準。
blocks.code:
python --version
python -m streamlit version
python -m pytest --version

paragraphs: 這裡有一個非常重要的細節：
查看 pytest 版本，不等於執行過測試。
執行 `python -m pytest --version` 只證明目前 Python 能呼叫 pytest 並顯示版本。
未來若要真正執行測試，通常才會使用：

blocks.heading: 範例 11｜步驟 3：確認安裝結果
paragraphs: 依本節用途執行或保存；輸出以實際執行為準。
而且還要確認專案裡有適當的測試案例，並檢查實際測試結果。

blocks.heading: 步驟 4：啟動網頁
paragraphs: 接著核對命令、用途與實際結果。

blocks.heading: 範例 12｜步驟 4：啟動網頁
paragraphs: 依本節用途執行或保存；輸出以實際執行為準。
這段指令的意思是：

- `python -m streamlit`：用目前的 Python 執行 Streamlit。
- `run starter/app.py`：啟動指定的應用程式。
- `--server.address 127.0.0.1`：讓服務只綁定在本機 loopback 位址。
成功時，終端機通常會顯示可以在瀏覽器開啟的本機網址。
但這個階段只需要確認起始骨架有正常開啟，不應期待已有完整的資料檢核和報表匯出功能。

blocks.heading: 步驟 5：正確停止
paragraphs: 接著核對命令、用途與實際結果。
在執行服務的終端機按下：

blocks.heading: 範例 13｜步驟 5：正確停止
paragraphs: 依本節用途執行或保存；輸出以實際執行為準。
這是停止目前前景服務的常見方法。
如果還要離開虛擬環境，可以再輸入：

blocks.heading: 範例 14｜步驟 5：正確停止
paragraphs: 依本節用途執行或保存；輸出以實際執行為準。
停止服務和離開虛擬環境是兩件不同的事。

sections.heading: 五、遇到問題時，怎麼知道是哪裡出了錯？
paragraphs: 下面這張表，是排查問題時非常實用的診斷架構。

blocks.caption: 表 3｜五、遇到問題時，怎麼知道是哪裡出了錯？

paragraphs: 例如一個物流公司正在開發出貨管理系統。
AI 完成程式碼後，執行時出現：

blocks.heading: 範例 15｜五、遇到問題時，怎麼知道是哪裡出了錯？
paragraphs: 依本節用途執行或保存；輸出以實際執行為準。
這通常先表示目前執行程式的 Python 找不到 Streamlit 套件。
合理的排查順序是：檢查正在使用哪個 Python、確認套件是否安裝在該環境、檢視安裝是否失敗。
錯誤發生在哪一層，就優先查哪一層。不要把每個錯誤都當成應用程式邏輯錯誤。

sections.heading: 六、為什麼 AI Coding Agent 特別需要這套紀律？
paragraphs: 因為 AI Agent 可能同時擁有修改程式和執行命令的能力。
假設你要求：
「把這個醫院預約系統做好，順便修復所有錯誤。」
AI 發現測試環境缺少某個套件。
不理想的做法，是直接修改大量程式碼，甚至刪掉測試，然後宣稱問題解決。
比較好的做法，是要求 Agent 先查明環境，再進行最小必要修改。
實務上可把工作分成三道驗收門：

blocks.caption: 表 4｜六、為什麼 AI Coding Agent 特別需要這套紀律？

paragraphs: 三者不可互相替代。
例如 G1、G2 通過，而 G3 尚未執行，就應如實記錄為「環境與骨架啟動成功，功能尚未驗收」。
這就是 AI 協作工程中非常重要的證據導向開發（Evidence-based Development）。

sections.heading: 七、最後要留下什麼成果？
paragraphs: 教材要求建立 `environment-notes.md`，作為環境與啟動結果的紀錄。
範本分六組記錄：(1) 專案名稱、根目錄與 README；(2) 作業系統、Python 版本與執行檔、Streamlit 與 pytest 版本；(3) 安裝命令、成功／失敗／未執行、退出結果與錯誤；(4) 啟動命令、本機網址、預期與實際畫面、停止狀態；(5) 完成、未實作與未驗證功能；(6) 待處理問題與下一個最小工作。請使用以下完整範本：

blocks.heading: 範例 16｜七、最後要留下什麼成果？
paragraphs: 依本節用途執行或保存；輸出以實際執行為準。

paragraphs: 不要把 `.venv` 當成備份提交到 Git。應保存程式碼、依賴規格和必要的環境紀錄，讓其他人可以重新建立環境。Python 官方文件也明確將虛擬環境視為可以重建、而非直接搬移的產物。

sections.heading: 八、今天最需要記住的四件事
paragraphs:
1. 找對位置： 確認終端機目前在哪個專案目錄。
2. 用對環境： 確認 Python 版本、虛擬環境及套件。
3. 分開驗證： 套件安裝、程式啟動、功能正確是三件事。
4. 留下證據： AI 說完成不算完成，必須能核對實際執行結果。
這一課的目的不是讓你背熟每一行終端機指令，而是建立一種工程判斷能力：
當 AI 幫你開發軟體時，你能知道它在哪個環境工作、做了什麼、哪些結果已確認，以及哪些事情根本還沒有完成。

sections.heading: 九、理解檢核
paragraphs: 假設你用 AI Agent 開發一個學校成績管理系統。AI 回報：
「Python 套件全部安裝成功，Streamlit 頁面也打開了，但成績統計和 Excel 匯出還沒做。」
問題 1：目前可以宣稱哪個階段完成？
A. 整個系統已完成
B. 環境建置與起始骨架啟動成功
C. 所有功能測試通過
問題 2：如果 Agent 說虛擬環境能阻止程式讀取其他資料夾，這句話正確嗎？
A. 正確，虛擬環境提供完整安全隔離
B. 不正確，它主要隔離 Python 套件環境
問題 3：如果 `pytest --version` 成功顯示版本，可以說自動化測試全部通過嗎？
A. 可以
B. 不可以，還需要真正執行測試並檢查結果
完成判讀後，可在本頁理解檢核區展開三題參考解析；此操作不提交答案或記錄學習進度。
下一個單元 M07-02「用規格約束 Agent 工作」，將進一步處理：環境準備好以後，如何讓 AI 只修改指定檔案、遵守需求規格，並提供可驗證的成果。

exercise.environment: 解壓後工作坊根目錄、Python 3.11／3.12、終端機與瀏覽器。
steps: 建立並啟用獨立環境，安裝 requirements.txt，記錄實際版本。
啟動 starter/app.py，在瀏覽器核對骨架訊息，再停止服務。
將成功、失敗與尚未執行的步驟分開記入 environment-notes.md。
exercise.expected: environment-notes.md 可讓同儕找到同一入口，並清楚知道骨架尚無哪些功能。
exercise.check: 能指出工作目錄與 Python 的差別；不把環境建置當成功能驗收。
exercise.cleanup: 停止本次啟動的服務，保留合成作品、Diff 與實際結果；不要覆蓋其他工作或留下真實資料。

openChecks.prompt: 問題 1｜目前可以宣稱哪個階段完成？
answer: B。環境建置與起始骨架啟動成功，只支持 G1／G2；成績統計與 Excel 匯出尚未實作，G3 尚未驗收。

openChecks.prompt: 問題 2｜虛擬環境能阻止讀取其他資料夾嗎？
answer: B。不正確，venv 主要隔離 Python 套件環境。檔案與網路權限需另外控制。

openChecks.prompt: 問題 3｜顯示 pytest 版本代表測試全部通過嗎？
answer: B。不可以。還需要適當測試案例、真正執行測試並檢查結果；版本輸出只支持工具可呼叫。

en.summary: Locate the project, selected Python and packages before starting the skeleton; record installation outcomes separately from feature acceptance.
objectives: Start the skeleton in a separate environment and record actual versions.
Distinguish working directory, interpreter, packages and execution entry point.
Preserve environment-failure diagnostics without claiming completed implementation.

readingGuide.goal: Start the skeleton in a separate environment and record actual versions.
readingGuide.startingPoint: The extracted workshop root, Python 3.11/3.12, a terminal and a browser.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: environment-notes.md lets a peer find the same entry point and identify features absent from the skeleton.

sections.heading: 1. What does this lesson teach?
paragraphs: Keep this working rule in mind:
Before writing code, establish where it will run, which tools it requires and how to demonstrate that it works.
That preparation creates a development environment.
Suppose you ask an AI:
“Build a system that lets employees upload Excel files, checks whether the data is complete and produces a report.”
The AI may quickly write several hundred lines of code.
You still need answers to these questions:

- Which directory holds the code?
- Is Python installed on this computer?
- Which packages must be installed?
- Why does the AI’s program run on another computer but fail on yours?
- Does opening the web page establish that the system is complete?
- If the AI reports passing tests, how can you confirm that it actually ran them?
This lesson teaches you how to answer those questions.
Successful environment setup, successful startup and correct feature behavior require separate evidence.

sections.heading: 2. Understand the environment through a restaurant
paragraphs: Imagine opening a beef noodle restaurant.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Eight restaurant and development roles
blocks.description: Each row pairs a restaurant role with a development role. These are analogies, with no sequence arrows. Preparation, implementation and acceptance need separate evidence.

paragraphs: Read the analogy this way:
Renting a shop, buying cooking equipment and preparing ingredients establish preparation; you still need to cook a good bowl of noodles.
Likewise, installing Python, opening a web page and seeing an interface establish only their respective stages.
Keep environment preparation, implementation and feature acceptance separate.

sections.heading: 3. Five technical concepts
paragraphs: Distinguish location, interpreter, package separation, dependencies and tool responsibilities.

blocks.heading: 1. Project directory: where are you working?
paragraphs: Check the commands, their purpose and actual outcomes below.
A project may contain this directory tree. The comment on `.venv` means that this directory appears after environment creation:

blocks.heading: Example 1 | 1. Project directory: where are you working?
paragraphs: Run or save this example for the purpose described. Record actual output. Shared templates retain the original Chinese field labels and comments.
blocks.code:
my-project/
├── README.md
├── requirements.txt
├── starter/
│   └── app.py
├── slices/
├── reference/
└── .venv/                 # 建立環境後才會出現

paragraphs: Each entry has a purpose:
A common mistake is assuming that opening a file also changes the terminal’s directory.
The editor and terminal can point to different locations.
You may see `app.py` in the editor while the terminal is in another directory.
If you run:

blocks.heading: Example 2 | 1. Project directory: where are you working?
paragraphs: Run or save this example for the purpose described. Record actual output. Shared templates retain the original Chinese field labels and comments.
The computer may report:
`Could not open requirements file`
It is looking for the file in the wrong location.
Start by confirming the current directory.

blocks.heading: Example 3 | 1. Project directory: where are you working?
paragraphs: Run or save this example for the purpose described. Record actual output. Shared templates retain the original Chinese field labels and comments.
These commands are common on Linux and macOS. Windows PowerShell provides `Get-Location` and `Get-ChildItem`.

blocks.heading: 2. Python interpreter: what actually executes the code?
paragraphs: Check the commands, their purpose and actual outcomes below.
Python is a programming language. The Python interpreter is the software that reads and executes Python code.
A computer may have several versions installed:

- Python 3.10
- Python 3.11
- Python 3.12
Think of a factory with production machines from different generations.
Running a program requiring Python 3.12 with Python 3.10 may cause syntax or package compatibility problems.
Check the version first:

blocks.heading: Example 4 | 2. Python interpreter: what actually executes the code?
paragraphs: Run or save this example for the purpose described. Record actual output. Shared templates retain the original Chinese field labels and comments.
Then identify the actual interpreter:

blocks.heading: Example 5 | 2. Python interpreter: what actually executes the code?
paragraphs: Run or save this example for the purpose described. Record actual output. Shared templates retain the original Chinese field labels and comments.
The second command displays the location of the Python executable.
Matching version numbers alone do not establish that two commands use the same Python environment.

blocks.heading: 3. Virtual environment: separate packages for each project
paragraphs: Check the commands, their purpose and actual outcomes below.
Package separation is a central concept in this lesson.
Suppose you develop three systems:

blocks.caption: Figure 2 | Three independent environments on one computer
blocks.description: The projects manage packages in parallel to avoid interference. Stacking does not indicate execution order. Virtual environments do not provide file or network security isolation.

items.title: Hospital imaging analysis system
items.body: Python 3.11 + a validated set of AI packages

items.title: Restaurant inventory system
items.body: Python 3.12 + another set of data-processing packages

paragraphs: One computer can host multiple independent project environments.
If all three projects share packages, updating packages for the restaurant system may unexpectedly break compatibility in the hospital system.
Python’s `venv` is one way to manage this separation.

blocks.heading: Example 6 | 3. Virtual environment: separate packages for each project
paragraphs: Run or save this example for the purpose described. Record actual output. Shared templates retain the original Chinese field labels and comments.
This command means:
“Use the currently selected Python to create a separate environment named `.venv` in this directory.”
It mainly separates Python packages and their execution environment.

A virtual environment does not provide a security sandbox. It does not automatically prevent file access, network connections or access to operating-system resources. Coding Agent permissions still require separate isolation and authorization controls.

blocks.heading: 4. Dependencies: which external tools does the program use?
paragraphs: Check the commands, their purpose and actual outcomes below.
Building a website does not require writing every feature from scratch.
For example:

- Use Streamlit for a web interface.
- Use pytest for automated tests.
- Use pandas for tabular data processing.
In Python, these reusable tools are generally called packages.
They are dependencies because your program relies on them to work.
For example, `requirements.txt` can contain:

blocks.heading: Example 7 | 4. Dependencies: which external tools does the program use?
paragraphs: Run or save this example for the purpose described. Record actual output. Shared templates retain the original Chinese field labels and comments.
These are the workshop’s two specified direct dependency versions.
The `==` operator requests an exact version.
Pinning direct dependencies does not necessarily lock every transitive dependency or guarantee identical behavior across operating systems.

blocks.heading: 5. Toolchain: which tools work together?
paragraphs: Check the commands, their purpose and actual outcomes below.
A toolchain connects tools with different responsibilities to complete development work.

blocks.caption: Table 2｜3. Five technical concepts
rows: Help read/write code, edit files and call authorized tools

paragraphs: Think of a Coding Agent as an engineer who can use tools.
An engineer operating a drill and the drill have different roles; likewise, the Agent can execute Python while Python remains the code execution tool.

sections.heading: 4. Practice: start a Python project
paragraphs: Use the course’s Streamlit workshop. Its specified versions are Python 3.11 or 3.12, Streamlit 1.51.0 and pytest 8.4.2.
Standard operating sequence

blocks.caption: Figure 3 | Five steps from project location to shutdown
blocks.description: Numbers and arrows indicate operating order. Check actual outcomes at each step; skeleton startup does not establish feature acceptance.

items.title: Find the correct project root
items.body: Confirm that README, requirements.txt and starter are in the expected locations.

items.title: Create and activate a virtual environment
items.body: Confirm that the selected Python meets the requirements.

items.title: Start the program
items.body: Observe the starting skeleton in the browser.

items.title: Stop and retain evidence
items.body: Stop the service properly and record successes, failures and unverified items.

blocks.heading: Step 1: create and activate the environment
paragraphs: Check the commands, their purpose and actual outcomes below.

blocks.caption: Figure 4 | Create and activate for your operating system
blocks.description: Choose the column matching your OS. These are alternative paths, not sequential steps. Confirm Python 3.11/3.12, then the executable path. Shared command snippets retain the original Chinese comments.

items.title: Linux / macOS
items.body:
# 在工作坊根目錄執行
python3 --version

# 確認為 Python 3.11 或 3.12 後建立環境
python3 -m venv .venv

# 啟用虛擬環境
source .venv/bin/activate

# 查看目前 Python
python --version
python -c "import sys; print(sys.executable)"

items.title: Windows PowerShell
items.body:
Get-Location
Get-ChildItem
py -3.12 --version
py -3.12 -m venv .venv
.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
python --version
python -c "import sys; print(sys.executable)"

paragraphs: Confirm that Python 3.11 or 3.12 is installed. This example selects 3.12; replace `-3.12` with `-3.11` when using 3.11. `py` is the Windows Python launcher; if it is absent, locate the interpreter through your actual Python installation.
If activation is unavailable, address the same environment’s interpreter directly:

blocks.heading: Example 8 | Step 1: create and activate the environment
paragraphs: Run or save this example for the purpose described. Record actual output. Shared templates retain the original Chinese field labels and comments.
blocks.code:
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m streamlit version
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest --version
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m streamlit run starter/app.py --server.address 127.0.0.1

paragraphs: If PowerShell policy prevents running activation scripts, investigate the policy. You can use the environment’s interpreter directly without relaxing the policy merely for convenience.

blocks.heading: Step 2: install packages
paragraphs: Check the commands, their purpose and actual outcomes below.

blocks.heading: Example 9 | Step 2: install packages
paragraphs: Run or save this example for the purpose described. Record actual output. Shared templates retain the original Chinese field labels and comments.
Why use `python -m pip` rather than just `pip`?
It runs pip with the currently selected Python, reducing the risk of installing into another environment.

blocks.heading: Step 3: confirm installation
paragraphs: Check the commands, their purpose and actual outcomes below.

blocks.heading: Example 10 | Step 3: confirm installation
paragraphs: Run or save this example for the purpose described. Record actual output. Shared templates retain the original Chinese field labels and comments.
blocks.code:
python --version
python -m streamlit version
python -m pytest --version

paragraphs: Keep these checks distinct:
Displaying the pytest version does not execute the tests.
`python -m pytest --version` establishes only that the selected Python can invoke pytest and display its version.
To actually run tests later, normally use:

blocks.heading: Example 11 | Step 3: confirm installation
paragraphs: Run or save this example for the purpose described. Record actual output. Shared templates retain the original Chinese field labels and comments.
Also confirm that appropriate test cases exist and inspect the actual test results.

blocks.heading: Step 4: start the web interface
paragraphs: Check the commands, their purpose and actual outcomes below.

blocks.heading: Example 12 | Step 4: start the web interface
paragraphs: Run or save this example for the purpose described. Record actual output. Shared templates retain the original Chinese field labels and comments.
Read the command in three parts:

- `python -m streamlit`: run Streamlit with the selected Python.
- `run starter/app.py`: start the specified application.
- `--server.address 127.0.0.1`: bind the service only to the local loopback address.
Successful startup normally prints a local URL that you can open in the browser.
At this stage, check that the skeleton opens correctly. Complete data validation and report export are not yet expected.

blocks.heading: Step 5: stop correctly
paragraphs: Check the commands, their purpose and actual outcomes below.
In the terminal running the service, press:

blocks.heading: Example 13 | Step 5: stop correctly
paragraphs: Run or save this example for the purpose described. Record actual output. Shared templates retain the original Chinese field labels and comments.
This commonly stops the foreground service.
To also leave the virtual environment, enter:

blocks.heading: Example 14 | Step 5: stop correctly
paragraphs: Run or save this example for the purpose described. Record actual output. Shared templates retain the original Chinese field labels and comments.
Stopping the service and deactivating the environment are separate actions.

sections.heading: 5. Diagnose the failed layer
paragraphs: Use this table to choose the first investigation:

blocks.caption: Table 3｜5. Diagnose the failed layer
rows: Page opens but export is absent

paragraphs: For example, a logistics company is developing a shipping management system.
After the AI writes code, execution reports:

blocks.heading: Example 15 | 5. Diagnose the failed layer
paragraphs: Run or save this example for the purpose described. Record actual output. Shared templates retain the original Chinese field labels and comments.
The selected Python cannot find Streamlit.
Check which Python is running, whether Streamlit is installed in that environment and whether installation failed.
Investigate the layer implicated by the error before treating it as application-logic failure.

sections.heading: 6. Why Coding Agents need this discipline
paragraphs: An AI Agent may both modify code and execute commands.
Suppose you request:
“Finish this hospital appointment system and fix all errors.”
The AI discovers that the test environment lacks a package.
Changing large amounts of code or deleting tests and then claiming success would obscure the environment problem.
Ask the Agent to inspect the environment first and make the smallest necessary change.
Use three acceptance gates:

blocks.caption: Table 4｜6. Why Coding Agents need this discipline

paragraphs: Evidence for one gate cannot substitute for another.
If G1 and G2 pass while G3 has not run, record: “Environment and skeleton startup succeeded; feature acceptance has not run.”
This is evidence-based development in AI collaboration: connect completion claims to observed results.

sections.heading: 7. Retain the outcome
paragraphs: Create `environment-notes.md` to record the environment and startup results.

Use this template. Its six groups record: (1) project name, root and README location; (2) operating system, Python version and executable, Streamlit and pytest versions; (3) installation command, success/failure/not run, exit outcome and errors; (4) startup command, local URL, expected/actual screen and successful shutdown; (5) completed, unimplemented and unverified features; (6) unresolved issues and the next smallest task. The shared workshop template below retains its original Chinese field labels:

blocks.heading: Example 16 | 7. Retain the outcome
paragraphs: Run or save this example for the purpose described. Record actual output. Shared templates retain the original Chinese field labels and comments.
blocks.code:
# Environment Notes

## 1. 專案資訊
- 專案名稱：
- 專案根目錄：
- README 位置：

## 2. 執行環境
- 作業系統：
- Python 版本：
- Python 執行檔位置：
- Streamlit 版本：
- pytest 版本：

## 3. 安裝結果
- 執行命令：
- 成功 / 失敗 / 未執行：
- 結束狀態與錯誤訊息：

## 4. 啟動結果
- 啟動命令：
- 本機網址：
- 預期畫面：
- 實際畫面：
- 是否成功停止服務：

## 5. 功能狀態
- 已完成：
- 尚未實作：
- 尚未驗證：

## 6. 下一步
- 待處理問題：
- 下一個最小工作：

paragraphs: Keep code, dependency specifications and necessary environment notes in version control so others can recreate the environment. Python documents virtual environments as disposable and recreatable rather than movable; exclude `.venv` from Git.

sections.heading: 8. Four working habits
paragraphs:
1. Locate the project: confirm the terminal’s current directory.
2. Select the environment: confirm Python version, virtual environment and packages.
3. Verify stages separately: package installation, startup and feature correctness need distinct checks.
4. Retain evidence: verify actual execution rather than relying on an AI’s completion claim.
Use commands to develop engineering judgment:
When AI helps build software, identify its working environment, the changes it made, the outcomes confirmed and the work still incomplete.

sections.heading: 9. Check your understanding
paragraphs: Suppose an AI Agent is building a school grade-management system and reports:
“All Python packages installed successfully and the Streamlit page opens, but grade statistics and Excel export have not been implemented.”
Question 1: which stage can you report as complete?
A. The entire system is complete
B. Environment setup and skeleton startup succeeded
C. All feature tests passed
Question 2: an Agent says a virtual environment prevents access to other directories. Is this correct?
A. Yes; it provides complete security isolation
B. No; it mainly separates Python package environments
Question 3: if `pytest --version` displays a version successfully, can you report that all automated tests passed?
A. Yes
B. No; actually run the tests and inspect the results
After making your judgment, expand the three reference explanations in the understanding-check area. This does not submit answers or record learning progress.
M07-02, “Constrain Agent work with a specification,” continues with limiting edits to specified files, following requirements and supplying verifiable outcomes after environment preparation.

exercise.environment: The extracted workshop root, Python 3.11/3.12, a terminal and a browser.
steps: Create and activate a separate environment, install requirements.txt and record actual versions.
Start starter/app.py, check its skeleton message in the browser, then stop the service.
Record successes, failures and unexecuted steps separately in environment-notes.md.
exercise.expected: environment-notes.md lets a peer find the same entry point and identify features absent from the skeleton.
exercise.check: Distinguish working directory from Python, and environment setup from feature acceptance.
exercise.cleanup: Stop only services you started for this exercise. Keep synthetic work, diffs and actual results; preserve other work and leave no real data.

openChecks.prompt: Question 1 | Which stage can you report as complete?
answer: B. Environment setup and skeleton startup support G1/G2 only. Grade statistics and Excel export are unimplemented; G3 has not been accepted.

openChecks.prompt: Question 2 | Does a virtual environment prevent access to other directories?
answer: B. No. venv mainly separates Python package environments. File and network permissions need separate controls.

openChecks.prompt: Question 3 | Does a pytest version establish that all tests passed?
answer: B. No. Appropriate test cases, actual test execution and inspection of results are still required. Version output establishes only that the tool can be invoked.
